performance_signal: student-only evaluation return (no teacher, no intervention), 16 episodes per eval point on seeds 900000+, every 50K env steps
target_R_star: R* = random_mean + 0.8 * (ppo_final_mean - random_mean), where ppo_final_mean is the mean over seeds of PPO-from-scratch final eval, and random_mean comes from runs/phase0/random
steps_to_target: per seed: first eval step whose 3-point trailing mean >= R*; runs that never reach it are censored at total_steps and reported as '>total'
interaction_accounting: teacher methods (bc, bc_ppo, fixed, reflexrl) are charged the env steps used to collect their Qwen labels (phase-0 teacher episodes for that scenario) on top of training steps. X is reported both with and without this charge; the charged number is the headline.
X_sample_efficiency: median over seeds of N_ppo(R*) / median over seeds of N_method(R*)
W_retention: method final eval mean / ppo final eval mean * 100, plus absolute returns for method, ppo, qwen and random
Y_speed: Qwen mean latency / reflex mean latency, batch 1, same GPU, end-to-end frame->action; P95 reported alongside
Z_cost: Qwen usd per 10K decisions / reflex usd per 10K decisions at one hourly price applied to both on the same GPU; reflex-on-1-CPU-core cost reported separately
uncertainty: mean +- standard error across seeds for curves; per-seed values listed in the results table
